decisions.reason: The white-label test pressing series was launched only in 2024 and its demand among collectors is still uncertain, while limited runs cost the established mail-order platform little to keep listed, so the option is worth holding until sales reveal its value, though small-batch test pressings carry some risk of quietly selling out and ending.

A German new wave compilation series fits closely with the in-house label and catalog depth, keeping it costs little once released, and one year of results is too early to show its value is unlikely to be realized, so the option stays open.
